mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high consumer spending as measured by retail sales (RSAFS) relative to historical averages signals robust demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates a supply shock that reduces corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity that drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals a monetary tightening cycle that reduces corporate profitability and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.
